messages:
Ava: Quick async check-in for OKR: runtime v2 rollout (Q2 milestone). Please post 1) what's shipped 2) what's slipped + root cause 3) next steps + owner(s) + any blocking deps. Tag me if you need a sync. Deadline for updates: EOD today. :spiral_calendar:

Liam: Shipped: canary runtime v2 on staging, perf regression fix merged (PR #482). Throughput tests look +12% on A100. Owner: @Liam. Notes: need one more perf run with 6k tokens.

Priya: Slipped: dedicated eviction policy and multi-tenant isolation tests. Cause: flaky test harness and missing infra quota in eu-west. Owner: @Priya. Next steps: repro in sandbox, open infra request by tomorrow, aim to finish by next Wed.

Rosa: Need a slice of telemetry to validate cache hit improvement. Can someone post the exact metric names? (prefix: runtime.v2.cache.*) I can run the dashboard.

Liam: metric names: runtime.v2.cache.hit_rate, runtime.v2.cache.prefix_hit, runtime.v2.latency.p50, runtime.v2.latency.p95. Also added a quick Grafana panel here: https://grafana.redwood/projects/runtime-v2

Priya: Also blocked on two code reviews: @Noah please review PR #491 (isolation tests), and @Liam please review PR #489 (eviction policy). Small changes but need eyes.

Noah: On it, will review tonight. ETA EOD. Flagging one potential API compatibility issue in the transition code.

Ava: For any infra quota requests, @infra-team please see Priya's comment. If we need extra capacity for eu-west canary, we can bump the burst pool temporarily.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: runtime-v2-staging -> canary-3 at 1719001450. Autoscaling events: +2 GPUs.

Liam: quick note — we observed a small memory regression on 2/1000 requests during canary, captured logs: ```ERROR: kv_cache overflow at shard 3
stack: ...
``` Investigating; might be related to the eviction policy.

Priya: repro steps I used: ```curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/samples -d '{"input":"<long prompt>"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``` Shared a minimal test in PR #491.

Rosa: I'll run analytics against the canary traffic and post a short chart by morning.

Ava: Owners recap: Liam (canary perf + logs), Priya (isolation & eviction tests + infra request), Rosa (telemetry + dashboard), Noah (CR reviews). If any of you need a 15-min sync, react with :phone: and I'll set up. Otherwise we'll treat this as async and check again Monday.

Liam: +1. Also pinging @security for the multi-tenant isolation review — can we get a quick look? @security-team

Priya: timeline update: if reviews land today and infra quota approved tomorrow, we can target a full rollout next Thu. If not, we slide to the following Tue.

Noah: PR #491 review done, left 2 comments. Minor. Will address tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: canary completed at 1719001820: health=degraded(1% errors) — auto-rollback NOT triggered. See runbook: https://runbooks/internal/canary-checks#runtime-v2

Ava: Thanks everyone. Quick action items at top: Priya to open infra ticket (PRIO=high), Liam to run extended perf test, Rosa to post metrics, Noah to merge after fixes. I'll follow up Monday with a short status email to execs. :email: 

Noah: ack. Merging once Priya's fixes applied.
